g.text: Observation encoder, once per action chunk (1.53 M parameters)
Velocity network v(a_τ, τ; c), once per flow step (7.09 M parameters)

svg.text: Each stage, in order:
Each depth image (depth scaled to [0, 1], and its
validity mask) goes through its own CNN: four
stride-2 convolutions, then one linear layer to a
64-vector. The two cameras do not share weights.
Proprioception: the last 3 frames of joint angles q
and of the policy's own targets q*, 3 × 2 × 29 = 174.
The text command, pick or place, as a one-hot.
Concatenate to 416 and mix with an MLP: the
observation vector c, computed once per chunk.
Per flow step:
The noised chunk a_τ = τ·a + (1 − τ)·ε is flattened
(8 × 29 = 232) and projected to x, 512.
τ gets a sinusoidal embedding and an MLP.
cond = [c | τ], 640, conditions every block.
FiLM: one linear layer maps cond to a scale γ and a
shift β for each of the 512 channels of LN(x).
x ← x + W₂ GELU(W₁ FiLM(LN(x))), 512 → 1024 → 512.
LN and a zero-initialised linear layer give the
velocity, reshaped to 8 × 29. A fresh policy outputs 0.
Euler steps from τ = 0 to 1. Training rollouts:
ε ~ N(0, I), K = 10. Deployment: ε = 0, K = 5 or 10.
The encoder runs once; steps 5–9 run K times.
Training target:
v should equal a − ε (conditional flow matching).
The loss is the squared error summed over the 232
numbers of a chunk; FPO++ compares it before and
after an update on the same (τ, ε).
Colours:
wrist camera
exo camera
proprioception
command, c and the output
